label: cellular buoyancy
definition: A physiology trait in which intracellular gas vesicles reduce a microbial cell's effective density enough to provide buoyancy and vertical positioning in the water column.
observations: Gas-vesicle-mediated physiology branch under phenotype; distinct from the gas vesicle organelle, generic mass density, gas-vesicle shell assembly outside an intact cell, downstream ultrasound scattering phenotypes, and water-column positioning processes that are not gas-vesicle mediated.
